name: Information Hierarchy
description: Content-aware layout and legibility modifiers that operate only on supplied entities, text and connections.
author: NidAll

styles.name: Supplied lettering clearance
styles.description: Decoration yields locally to text that is actually present in the base.

clauses.text: Where the base supplies lettering, keep those exact characters clearly separated from nearby decoration; otherwise add no text
tags: preserve supplied lettering with clear local separation

clauses.text: Keep coarse surface effects away from the interiors of supplied letters
tags: surface effects outside supplied letter interiors

styles.name: Leader-line clearance
styles.description: Already specified diagram connections retain distinct endpoints.

clauses.text: If the base specifies diagram connectors, keep their endpoints distinct and leave their stated connections unchanged
tags: distinct endpoints for supplied diagram connectors

clauses.text: Route only already supplied connector lines through available negative space without adding nodes or labels
tags: supplied connectors use existing negative space

styles.name: Parallel-script rhythm
styles.description: Existing paired text lines keep their original order and separate baselines.

clauses.text: If the base supplies parallel text lines, keep their stated order and give each an independent baseline
tags: separate baselines for supplied parallel text lines

clauses.text: Preserve each supplied script and punctuation without transliteration or invented translation

styles.name: Surface-following inscription
styles.description: Requested text follows its supplied support without changing spelling.

clauses.text: When text is specified on an object, align only that supplied inscription with its stated support surface
tags: supplied inscription aligned to its support

clauses.text: Keep the supplied wording intact as its letterforms follow the existing surface perspective
tags: exact supplied wording in surface perspective

styles.name: Glyph counter space
styles.description: Small supplied letter interiors remain distinguishable under a style treatment.

clauses.text: Keep counters and narrow gaps inside supplied letterforms open without changing the characters
Reduce local grain only where it would close those supplied letter interiors
tags: reduced grain inside supplied letter interiors

styles.name: Depth-separated labels
styles.description: Existing labels remain associated with the right supplied object plane.

clauses.text: Keep each supplied label attached to its specified entity and depth plane without creating new labels
tags: supplied labels retain entity and depth association

clauses.text: Use local edge separation to distinguish overlapping supplied labels while retaining their order
tags: local edge separation of supplied labels

styles.name: Entity-count readability
styles.description: All supplied entities remain separately recognizable in a dense composition.

clauses.text: Keep each explicitly counted entity separately readable without duplicating or dropping any of them
Retain identifying boundaries at existing overlaps rather than inventing substitute props

styles.name: Relationship continuity
styles.description: Stylistic abstraction keeps named adjacency and containment relationships.

clauses.text: Retain the base prompt's stated adjacency, containment and front-to-back relationships during stylization
tags: retain stated adjacency containment and depth

clauses.text: Emphasize the existing contact or overlap boundaries that make those relationships readable
tags: readable existing contact and overlap boundaries
